About Monte Carlo

Monte Carlo is the agent trust platform that autonomously observes, fixes, and continuously improves agents and the data that powers them — so enterprises can scale trust at the speed of AI. Bayes, our AI teammate, does the work: detecting, triaging, troubleshooting, and fixing issues in AI agents and the data powering them. The result is self-improving agents that get better with every fix instead of drifting. More than 400 enterprises, including Amazon, PepsiCo, CNN, Nasdaq, and JetBlue, rely on Monte Carlo. Learn more at montecarlo.ai.

 

The Role

We're hiring a Digital Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition at Monte Carlo, focused on LinkedIn Ads and Google paid search and display. We're creating a new category with Agent Trust, and paid digital is how we put it in front of data and AI leaders at the right accounts. You'll own a multimillion-dollar paid budget across these channels and use AI orchestration and intent data to run campaigns at a scale a single person couldn't handle manually.

What You'll Do

  • Build, launch, and optimize LinkedIn Ads and ABM display campaigns (Influ2 or similar) aimed at data, AI, and engineering leaders at target enterprise accounts.

  • Run Google Ads search and display end to end: keyword strategy, bidding, ad copy, landing page testing, and budget pacing.

  • Use AI orchestration and intent data tools like Clay to build audiences, prioritize in-market accounts, and automate copy variation and reporting, so paid drives more qualified pipeline, faster.

  • Own and pace a multimillion-dollar paid budget: track spend, CPL, pipeline, and ROI by channel, and report clearly on what's working, what isn't, and where the next dollar should go.

  • Work with the marketing team to bring Bayes, our AI teammate, to market, turning its story into paid campaigns that show how Bayes delivers self-improving agents and the data powering them.

  • Run a steady testing cadence across creative, audiences, and offers, and write down what you learn so the team can reuse it.

What We're Looking For

  • Paid acquisition depth. 4–6 years running paid digital campaigns hands-on, with LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads (search and display), and ABM display (Influ2 or similar) as your core channels. You've managed a multimillion-dollar budget and can show results tied to pipeline, not just clicks.

  • AI orchestration and intent data. You know how to use AI orchestration and intent data tools like Clay to improve conversion rates and qualified pipeline velocity. You can walk us through the actual workflow.

  • Analytical rigor. You're comfortable in spreadsheets and ad platform data, you know your attribution basics, and you make optimization calls from data, not instinct.

  • B2B instincts. You know how to reach technical buyers with long sales cycles, and how paid fits into account-based programs. B2B SaaS experience preferred.

  • Nice to have: Email nurture programs, HubSpot, and Salesforce campaign tracking.

This Is Not For You If

  • Your experience is mostly across digital marketing (SEO, social, email, web), with limited hands-on ownership of paid.

  • You've mostly managed agencies rather than running campaigns yourself, or you haven't owned a paid budget in the millions.

  • AI tools aren't already part of how you work.

  • You're looking for a pure B2C or ecommerce performance role.

#LI-REMOTE

#BI-REMOTE

Why Monte Carlo

  • We created the data observability category, and we're doing it again with agent trust — you'll build where the market is forming, not where it's settled

  • Series D, $236M raised, backed by Accel, Redpoint, Notable Capital, ICONIQ Growth, and Salesforce Ventures

  • Customers include HubSpot, Fox, Nasdaq, Toast, and Mercado Libre — your work ships to enterprises with real stakes

  • Snowflake Partner of the Year and a verified connector in Anthropic's Claude AI directory

  • Remote-first by design since day one, and recognized as a Best Workplace for it

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and a remote-first environment.

Come As You Are

Equality is a core tenet of Monte Carlo's culture. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. 

Monte Carlo is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are proud to be recognized for our world-class employee experience:

Monte Carlo Named 2025 Databricks Data Governance Partner of the Year

We were recently recognized as the #1 Data Observability Platform by G2 for the 4th consecutive quarter. See our G2 reviews here!

Monte Carlo Named to G2's Best Software Products of 2026

Monte Carlo was featured on Database Trends and Applications (DBTA’s) Trend-Setting Products for 2025!

We are super proud to be named the 2026 Best Place to Work by Built In!

Beware of Imposter Recruiters and Job Scams

  • All official communication from our recruiting team will come from an @montecarlodata.com email address.

  • We will never ask candidates to provide sensitive personal information (such as bank details, social security numbers, or payment) at any stage of the recruitment process.

  • We will never request payment for equipment, training, or application processing.

  • Our open positions are always listed on our official careers page: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/montecarlodata.

If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent Monte Carlo but you’re unsure of their legitimacy, please reach out to us directly at recruiting@montecarlodata.com before sharing any personal information.
